---
applyTo: 'libs/shared/i18n/**/*,**/*i18n*,**/assets/i18n/**/*'
---

# i18n / Transloco review

## Comment only on

- Missing keys in one or more of `en`, `nl`, `de`, `fr`, `el`, `es`
- Hard-coded user-facing strings that should use Transloco
- Broken key paths or inconsistent nesting vs `en`

## Do not comment on

- Preferring Angular compile-time i18n over Transloco (project choice is Transloco)
- Translating brand names (SilverVibe, VibeStandup)
- Style-only JSON formatting (CI Prettier handles it)
